brief:
Israeli aircraft carried out an airstrike on Saturday targeting the roof of a house located near Abu Sharia government office in the Shebura neighborhood of south Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The strike resulted in minor material damage to the structure, with no injuries sustained in the operation.

The attack represents a continuation of Israeli military operations across the Gaza Strip. Residential areas in the southern part of Gaza City have faced repeated airstrikes in recent months, with varying degrees of damage and civilian impact reported across multiple neighborhoods in the region.
